posts.text: The AI Revolution is dividing the software industry: The US Infrastructure Software Index and the US Security Software Index are up +22%, year-to-date, outperforming other parts of the industry. At the same time, the US Vertical Software Index and the US Application Software Index are down -28% and -34%, respectively. This brings the broad US Software Index down to -13% year-to-date. This comes as the AI boom is driving unprecedented demand for cloud infrastructure, data centers, and the cybersecurity software needed to protect them, boosting infrastructure and security companies. Meanwhile, application and vertical software companies are under pressure as investors fear AI will automate more tasks, reduce demand for traditional software licenses, and lower switching costs, making it easier for customers to change providers. The AI software trade is becoming increasingly fragmented.
posts.author: KobeissiLetter
